properties.name: Users
properties.description: Number of times this data-block is referenced

properties.description: Indicates whether an extra user is set or not (mainly for internal/debug usages)

properties.name: Embedded Data
properties.description: This data-block is not an independent one, but is actually a sub-data of another ID (typical example: root node trees or master collections)

properties.name: Linked Packed
properties.description: This data-block is linked and packed into the .blend file

properties.name: Missing Data
properties.description: This data-block is a place-holder for missing linked data (i.e. it is [an override of] a linked data that could not be found anymore)

properties.name: Runtime Data
properties.description: This data-block is runtime data, i.e. it won't be saved in .blend file. Note that e.g. evaluated IDs are always runtime, so this value is only editable for data-blocks in Main data-base.

properties.name: Editable
properties.description: This data-block is editable in the user interface. Linked data-blocks are not editable, except if they were loaded as editable assets.

properties.name: Tag
properties.description: Tools can use this to tag data for their own purposes (initial state is undefined)

properties.name: Is Indirect
properties.description: Is this ID block linked indirectly

properties.description: Weak reference to a data-block in another library .blend file (used to re-use already appended data instead of appending new copies)
